fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_IDLE_OR_RUNNING
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Continuous data streaming; no idle state — once enabled, SCK runs continuously and SD outputs one bit per SCK period.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_WS_TRANSITION
fsm_states_transmitter.description: On the SCK period where WS changes, transmitter prepares to send MSB of the next channel's word.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_MSB_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: One SCK period after WS change: drive the MSB on SD.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive each subsequent bit of the word on SD, MSB → LSB.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_AFTER_LSB
fsm_states_transmitter.description: If transmitter word is shorter than what receiver expects, transmitter LSBs are zero-padded; if longer, extra bits beyond receiver capacity are ignored.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LATCH_WS
fsm_states_receiver.description: On each leading edge of SCK, latch WS to know current channel.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LATCH_SD
fsm_states_receiver.description: On the same leading edge, latch the SD bit.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_ON_WS_CHANGE
fsm_states_receiver.description: When WS change is detected, store previous word and clear input for next word.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_MSB_AT_WS+1
fsm_states_receiver.description: Expect MSB of next word one SCK period after the WS change.

fsm_hints.trigger: Continuous SCK runs whenever the bus is active. No start/stop framing.
fsm_hints.rule: WS edge + 1 SCK period later = MSB of next word. Receiver latches SD and WS on every leading edge of SCK.
fsm_hints.abort: Stopping SCK (controller's responsibility) halts the stream gracefully; no special protocol abort.

anti_deadlock_rule: Single transmitter on SD line at a time; controller is unambiguous (whichever device generates SCK + WS). No multi-master arbitration.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-on / reset, controller drives SCK + WS in stable idle state; transmitter starts driving SD when ready; receiver synchronizes via WS edges.

default_ready_state_recommendation.WS_idle: Either polarity is valid; WS toggles between channels.
default_ready_state_recommendation.SD_idle: Not specified — receiver may sample garbage outside an active channel; rely on WS to delimit words.

configurations.name: Receiver as Controller
configurations.description: Receiver drives SCK + WS; transmitter drives SD under external clock.

configurations.name: Separate System Controller
configurations.description: A separate IC drives SCK + WS; transmitter drives SD under external clock; receiver consumes SD.

timing_dependency_rule: Transmitter may use either edge of SCK to drive new data, but receiver always latches on the leading (LOW-to-HIGH) edge. Total target-side delay = (external clock → internal clock delay) + (internal clock → data/WS output delay). For data and word-select inputs, the external→internal delay is of no consequence because it only lengthens the effective setup time.
